description: Defines the AOS_ContractsViewDetail class for rendering detailed views of AOS Contracts, including methods for displaying HTML popups and populating contract templates from the database.

classes.name: AOS_ContractsViewDetail
classes.description: View class for displaying detailed information about AOS Contracts, including popup HTML for template selection.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the contract detail view, including populating templates and rendering popup HTML.

methods.name: populateContractTemplates
methods.description: Fetches active AOS PDF templates of type 'AOS_Contracts' from the database and populates a global list for dropdown display.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Outputs HTML and JavaScript for a popup interface to select and generate PDF templates related to AOS Contracts.
